hypothesis.statement: The gait kinematics (sagittal knee + ankle flexion angles) and kinetics (antero-posterior + vertical GRF) have a strong linear canonical relationship: the first canonical correlation is substantially > 0 on real WBDS treadmill-walking data, and cca reproduces base R's stats::cancor to machine precision.

analysis_plan.dataset: WBDS (Fukuchi, Fukuchi & Duarte 2018, figshare 5722711, CC-BY 4.0): sagittal knee + ankle flexion angles (kinematics) and antero-posterior + vertical GRF (kinetics), time-aligned to 450 samples; WBDS01 for the terminal proof, all five subjects for the robustness benchmark (the SAME blocks as the dCor and RSA cases)

decision.threshold: descriptive: the first canonical correlation is substantially > 0 (~0.7) AND cca equals stats::cancor to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9)
